frozen_law.minimum_evidence: At least 30 settled nonflat signals in each chronological half, with success fractions above 0.5 overall and in each half.
frozen_law.missing_data_and_censoring: No fill or imputation; gaps split segments; preserve admitted signals without a full contiguous response as right-censored.
frozen_law.response: Directional close-to-close response after 12 exact contiguous M5 bars.
frozen_law.signal: 12-close population-standard-deviation z-score, including the completed signal bar; threshold ±2; fade the excursion.
frozen_law.statistic: One-sided exact binomial test on settled nonflat signals; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across 41 representatives at q=0.05.
